searchText: Off chain payments (aka mev) increased dramatically post 1559 though so I suspect that would alter this graph (but have no idea how it would alter it) if included. Do we expect an increase of gas price post merge? Depending on flashbot adoption post merge, the public mempool gas competitions might return (and an increase of failed tx) There isn't any strong reason to expect significant changes in gas costs with the merge other than potential changes in usage patterns (which is anyone's guess). I think <@97774605351010304> has a point, miners currently do have a MEV machinery in place and it's rare to see a block with normal ordering. There's no reason to expect that every validator (in particular solo stakers) will be participating with relays. At least for a while I'd expect many people running the default setup Why do you expect that? because mev boost will be a last minute thingy prior to the merge, large operations need implementation time and individual stakers are probably not even aware yet Isn't it already implemented in some clients? (I haven't been following closely) not that i am aware of. maybe on kiln? The average staking pool doesn’t even know mev exists I can’t say which but one of the largest ones took me for dinner and they had no idea about mev or tips 😅 because most people run stock geth and do not update their software unless they are told several weeks in advance and repeteadly. Most of our Discord users have no clue about how MEV-Boost will be implemented and we'll be lucky to see if their recipient fee is set correctly instead of the default burn address. Surely big staking pools will be ready to exploit MEV, but I don't expect the same from a dappnode user that bought a box and has only upgraded for Altair. the API hasn't even been finalized and there were still discussions in dev-connect. I sincerely doubt that come the merge, we will be seeing most blocks as today including bundles built by searchers It’ll be interesting to see the same apathy and stupidity you see from some miners carried over to stakers despite the increased money invested. Our biggest support complaint today was why are my earnings higher despite us having an announcement telling everyone they would be due to bigger blocks that tagged everyone. I don’t think that’s true - every pool I have talked to is well aware of it When did you talk to them? The one I met was a few months ago so maybe they are learning now that the merge is getting closer. I regularly talk with a few of them, as well as with the Flashbots team I don’t have a very thorough tracking, but it seems like Flashbots is well aware of who they need to reach out to, and what needs to be done to get MEV-boost ready. Notion of a swaps market for blockspace is kinda interesting…has anyone looked into this? Wonder if a good implementation of something like this on ethereum would be more conducive to allowing smaller validators / at-home-stakers to operate more comfortably: https://www.aniccaresearch.tech/blog/consensus-capital-markets according to this https://dashboard.flashbots.net/, only around 50% of blocks have flashbots bundles, so I'm not sure we need to be worried about the impact on the network if the FB penetration level drops anyway it will be an interesting experiment to see how the network performs without it *80% ? Do you have another data set? I asked in the nimbus discord how mev builders would get incentive for providing the service, and got this response > Builders buys the spot to the validator, and get the reward from the block > At least that's my understanding > So, as a builder, if I manage to build a block with a 1 eth reward to myself, I can buy the spot to the validator for 0.9 eth > > The validator chooses whichever is the most profitable for him > (figures are obviously fictional) just making sure this is true, do we have an estimate of who will run mev builders?
